issues.title: Doctor dropdown has no accessible name
issues.description: The doctor picker is announced as "combobox" with no name. The visible word "Doctor" is plain text that is not associated with the control, so a screen reader user has to guess what it is for.
issues.fix:
Associate the visible text with the control using a real <label>:

<label for="doctor">Doctor</label>
<select id="doctor" name="doctor">
  <option value="">Choose a doctor</option>
  <option>Dr. Patel</option>
  <option>Dr. Lee</option>
  <option>Dr. Okafor</option>
</select>

issues.title: "Full name" field is labelled only by its placeholder
issues.description: The name field has no label; its name comes from the placeholder text, which disappears as soon as the user starts typing and is not reliably announced by every screen reader.
issues.fix:
Add a visible, programmatic label and keep the placeholder for examples only:

<label for="name">Full name</label>
<input id="name" name="name" autocomplete="name">

issues.title: Time slots cannot be selected with a screen reader
issues.description: The available times (9:00, 10:30, 14:00) are clickable <div>s. They have no role, cannot receive keyboard focus and are announced as plain text, so a blind user can hear the times but has no way to choose one. Because a time is required, the booking cannot be completed.
issues.fix:
Use native radio buttons inside a fieldset; they are focusable, announced and selectable with the keyboard:

<fieldset>
  <legend>Available times</legend>
  <label><input type="radio" name="time" value="09:00"> 9:00</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="time" value="10:30"> 10:30</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="time" value="14:00"> 14:00</label>
</fieldset>

Style the labels as tiles with CSS if you want to keep the current look.

issues.title: Email field has no label
issues.description: The email field is announced as "textbox" with nothing else. The agent only guessed its purpose from its position after "Full name"; a screen reader user navigating by form fields would get no clue at all.

issues.title: Submit button has no accessible name, and its disabled state is unexplained
issues.description: The submit button contains only an icon, so it is announced as "button" with no name. It is also disabled until a time slot is chosen, without any message explaining why, so a screen reader user cannot tell what is missing.
issues.fix:
Give the button visible text (or at least an accessible name), and keep it enabled so you can explain errors on submit: On submit, show the error next to the field and announce it:

Please choose a time.

issues.title: Navigation link has no accessible name
issues.description: A link in the header contains only an icon and is announced as "link" with no name, so its purpose cannot be determined.

issues.title: Clinic logo has no text alternative
issues.description: The logo image in the header has no alt attribute, so screen readers announce it as an unlabelled image (or read out the file name).
